 Review the factory reset
 ProtoArc EM11 Pro 7B/04 (260d-1282-7b04) · profile none · firmware v1.00
 Ready: enter runs the checks, then asks you to confirm.

 What it does
   · First a full backup: arcctl reads the whole configuration afresh and saves
     it, labelled "auto before reset". The reset stops there if any range
     cannot be read.
   · Then one factory reset (cmd 9), sent once and never again; arcctl waits up
     to 3 s for its reply.
   · With or without a reply, arcctl reads the whole configuration again and
     compares it with the backup: the comparison says what the reset changed.
   · Nothing else is sent: no long-range or receiver-light command follows it.
   ✓ Hardware test H7 recorded the reset on this model with firmware v1.00 on
     2026-10-01.
   ! If the mouse stops answering afterwards, it may need pairing again: see
     "Re-pairing without arcctl" in docs/safety.md. Keep another pointing
     device at hand; the mouse's Bluetooth channel keeps working.
